inputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.constructor.store
inputs.description: The backing store instance retained by the service and called for availability checks, reads, and writes. Construction does not load or validate a record.

inputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.enrol.state
inputs.description: The mutable record enrolment uses if its queued turn is still wanted. It is retained by reference, and enrolment changes only enabled, origin, and generation.

inputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.enrol.registered
inputs.description: The registration values copied onto state when wanted() is true in enrol's turn. It contains only enabled, origin, and generation, leaving the other record fields intact.

inputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.enrol.wanted
inputs.description: A synchronous predicate evaluated when enrol reaches its turn. Returning false skips the mutation and write.

outputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.available
outputs.description: Whether the injected store currently reports itself available. The service returns the store's boolean directly.

outputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.load
outputs.description: The in-memory record when present, otherwise the shared read from the store; null means no record was found. A failed read rejects and clears the shared read so a later call can retry.

outputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.save
outputs.description: A promise for completion of this queued write. It writes the in-memory record at its turn and does nothing if the record is null.

outputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.off
outputs.description: A promise for the queued disable and write. It disables a known record immediately; if none is known, it tries a load and writes the disabled record when one is found. Read failures are swallowed, while save failures reject.

outputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.enrol
outputs.description: Whether the registration was applied in its queued turn; false means wanted() was false at that time. State is updated in place on success, while a failed save restores the prior service value and does not turn access back on if state was disabled meanwhile.

outputs.name: RemoteHostRecordService.settled
outputs.description: Resolves after every change queued before the call has ended, whether its work resolved or rejected. It does not wait for changes queued afterward.

errors.name: unknown
errors.description: The original value thrown or rejected by a store method or the wanted callback is propagated. off() swallows read failures but still propagates a save failure.

errors.name: unknown
errors.description: A store.read() failure is swallowed by off(), but a rejection from store.save() propagates.
